limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime account; no independent runtime inspection was performed.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; null dimensions are excluded.
The requested threshold is not met: several screens and components have A or F below 9.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; viewport-edge cropping in scrolled captures is not treated as unreachable content where browser reachability is explicitly reported.
Physical iPhone, Dynamic Type, native keyboard, audible VoiceOver, native haptics/frame rate, OS sharing, notifications and payments remain unverified without automatic browser-score deductions.
Authenticated Circle behavior lacks browser evidence because Supabase is unconfigured; the Circle scores cover only demonstrated offline and retry states.
Speech, sharing and clipboard ports are mocked, and billing is simulated; these scores do not certify successful external delivery or payment.
Synthetic long text, layout errors and controlled predictions establish presentation coverage, not production copy defects or predictive quality.
The retained 200ms Share frame gap remains unexplained despite a clean repeat; consistent performance across representative browser sessions is not established.
Screenshots and reported axe/DOM checks do not establish repeated novice success or complete assistive-technology usability.
topFixes: Preserve the daily omen attempt when generation fails and offer manual recovery for storage errors.
Differentiate suggested check-in dates from scheduled reminders throughout forecasts and history.
Make enlarged secondary headings less dominant, especially in Circles, profile and plan screens.
Standardize navigation versus disclosure indicators and make the context sent with a question inspectable.
Simplify invitation fallback URLs and give export failure one dominant recovery action.
Resolve the retained Share frame-gap uncertainty and add browser proof for source-link destinations.
